sn22.116:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.116:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante dhammakathiko hoti ||
sn22.116:1.5: kittāvatā dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti || kittāvatā diṭṭhadhammanibbānapatto hotīti || || 3
sn22.116:1.6: Rūpassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti Dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alam vacanāya || ||
sn22.116:1.7: Rūpassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti Dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alam vacanāya || ||
sn22.116:1.8: Rūpassa ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti Diṭṭhadhammanibbānapatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanaya || || 4-6
sn22.116:1.12: Viññāṇassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti Dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanaya || ||
sn22.116:1.13: Viññāṇassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti Dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya || ||
sn22.116:1.14: Viññāṇassa ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti Diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāyāti || || 1-2
